candidate.answerReason: A parabola is defined by equality of the distance to its focus and the perpendicular distance to its directrix.

methods.label: Apply the parabola definition
methods.explanation: A parabola does not have 2 foci. It is the locus of points whose distances to the focus and to the directrix are equal.
